Version 3 wins for me. Being able to tap an existing tag should make tagging faster and prevent slightly different versions of the same label, while still letting me create a new one when needed.

The soft green tags are clear and well placed beneath the description, and they don’t look like the grey source information. Lower-casing them also feels right. I’d want those existing-tag suggestions to narrow down as I type once the collection becomes large, but this is the tagging approach I’d choose.
